description: The file defines the 'Connect' class used to represent a message for establishing a streaming connection in the system. It encapsulates relevant connection parameters such as the publisher queue, correlation ID, connection type, schema version, optional session expiration, and acknowledgement labels.

classes.name: Connect
classes.description: A data class representing a message to initiate a streaming connection, including session parameters, acknowledgement labels, and a source queue for events and responses.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields for a new Connect message, ensuring non-null connectionCorrelationId.

methods.name: getEventAndResponsePublisher
methods.description: Returns the source queue used to push events and responses.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID of the connection/session.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the streaming connection.

methods.name: getSessionExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the session expiration time if set.

methods.name: getJsonSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema version associated with this connection request.

methods.name: getDeclaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgement labels declared for this session.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Connect object based on core properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the object's fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Connect object.
